    """
    EngineModule35 implementation supporting process(data) and get_status().
    """
    def __init__(self):
        self._status = "ready"
        self._last_processed = None

    def process(self, data):
        """
        Process the given input data and update internal status.
        Returns a dictionary containing the processing status and input/result data.
        """
        self._last_processed = data
        self._status = "success"
